name: Machine Learning Engineer
responsibilities: Design, build, and evaluate machine learning models against a real dataset, not a toy benchmark, then justify the architecture choice
Write clean, efficient, scalable code that takes a model from a notebook to something a team can run and extend
Analyze complex or unstructured datasets to find the signal a model should be learning, and communicate what you found
skills: Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) used on an actual dataset, not just tutorials
Foundations that don't go stale: linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistics behind the models you train
Shipping at least one end-to-end ML project you can defend in an interview: data, training, evaluation, and failure modes
Working with messy, high-volume, or time-series data instead of a cleaned CSV
rawSkillPool: Deep learning model design and evaluation
Linear algebra, calculus, and probability foundations
Time series and unstructured data handling
Model training, validation, and evaluation metrics
Reading and communicating research or dataset findings
